mapper.select: select site_route from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' group by site_route
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and site_route = #{siteRoute}
select count(1) from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and site_route = #{siteRoute} and warning_grade = #{warningGrade}
select node_id from tb_early_warning where is_affirm = '2' and site_route = #{siteRoute} and warning_grade = #{warningGrade} and ${warningType}
SELECT ts.site_name as siteName, tm.principal_name as name FROM tb_stack ts inner join tb_maintain_plan tm on tm.stack_id = ts.id and tm.is_end = '0' where ts.id = #{stackId}
select principal_name as principalName, site_name as siteName, floor_id as floorId from tb_ware_area where id = #{areaId}
select principal_name as principalName, building_id as buildingId from tb_floor where id = #{floorId}
select principal_name as principalName, warehouse_id as warehouseId from tb_building where id = #{buildingId}
select principal_name as principalName from tb_warehouse where id = #{warehouseId}
